T: Welcome to the family. Dinner's on.
D: The Byrnes family travel to Florida to meet the Focker parents before the wedding.
P: Serve the mains when the two families sit down together.
S: Miami ham croquetas with lime aioli

Crisp crumbed Cuban croquettes with a creamy ham béchamel centre, fried golden and served with a garlicky lime aioli. Melt 60g butter, stir in 80g plain flour for 2 minutes, then slowly whisk in 500ml milk until very thick. Stir in 200g finely chopped leg ham, a pinch of nutmeg and pepper. Spread on a tray, cover and chill 3 hours. Shape into 16 small logs, roll in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and coat in 120g breadcrumbs. Fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Mix 150g mayonnaise with 1 crushed garlic clove and lime juice.
the Fockers' laid-back home in Coconut Grove

Crisp Florida-style fritters packed with chopped prawns, capsicum and spring onion, served with a tangy key lime and chilli dipping sauce. Chop 400g peeled green prawns. Mix 150g self-raising flour, 1 egg, 150ml soda water, 1/2 diced red capsicum, 2 sliced spring onions, 1/2 tsp Cajun seasoning and salt into a thick batter, then fold in the prawns. Drop heaped tablespoons into oil at 180C and fry 3 minutes, turning, until golden. Drain. For the sauce, mix 100g mayonnaise, 2 tbsp sweet chilli sauce and the juice of 2 limes.
M: the two families at the Focker table

Pork shoulder marinated in garlic, orange, lime and cumin, slow-roasted until tender, with black beans, rice and fried sweet plantain or banana. Blitz 8 garlic cloves, the juice of 2 oranges and 2 limes, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp dried oregano, 60ml olive oil and salt. Rub over a 1.5kg boneless pork shoulder and marinate overnight. Roast covered at 160C for 3 hours, then uncovered at 200C for 30 minutes. Fry 1 onion and 1 capsicum, add 2 drained tins black beans and 1 tsp cumin and simmer 10 minutes. Serve with 300g rice and 2 sliced bananas fried in butter.
W: A sharp, creamy lime custard set in a crunchy biscuit base, topped with whipped cream and fresh lime zest. Crush 200g plain sweet biscuits and mix with 80g melted butter. Press into a 23cm pie dish and bake at 180C for 8 minutes. Whisk 4 egg yolks with a 395g tin condensed milk, then whisk in 150ml lime juice and the zest of 2 limes. Pour into the base and bake at 160C for 15 minutes until just set. Cool, then chill 3 hours. Top with 300ml whipped cream and more lime zest.
K: White rum muddled with fresh mint, lime and sugar, topped with soda over crushed ice. Leave out the rum for a virgin mojito. In each of 4 tall glasses, muddle 8 mint leaves with half a lime cut into wedges and 2 tsp caster sugar until the sugar dissolves. Fill with crushed ice. Pour 45ml white rum into each, then top with 120ml soda water. Stir from the bottom with a long spoon to pull the mint up through the ice. Garnish with a big mint sprig and a lime wheel.
